channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Oposição critica Lula por mostrar dedo do meio em discurso
item.description: President Lula faced criticism from the opposition after showing the middle finger during a speech defending quality public services for low-income populations. Opposition figures including Flávio Bolsonaro, Rubinho Nunes, Romeu Zema, and Mario Frias used the gesture to attack the government, linking it to corruption or disrespect, with Zema framing it as directed at 'decent Brazilians' and accusing the PT of successive scandals.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro se despede do PL Mulher: "Uma nova história"
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro bid farewell to PL Women after announcing her resignation as president of the Liberal Party's women's wing, emphasizing a 'new cycle' and thanking the team for their dedication. Her decision, made following discussions with Jair Bolsonaro and Valdemar Costa Neto, aims to allow her to focus entirely on caring for her husband and daughter. The resignation came amid a public dispute with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, whom she accused of humiliating and disrespecting her.

item.title: TRE manda deputado do PT apagar vídeo de Tarcísio como boneco Chucky
item.description: The São Paulo Regional Electoral Court (TRE-SP) ordered the removal of a video posted by state deputy Emídio de Souza (PT) depicting Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) as the Chucky doll, linking him to violence, femicide, and criminality. Judge Domitila Manssur ruled the content constitutes negative electoral propaganda and irregular use of AI, lacking clear disclosure of manipulation, thus exceeding the bounds of protected political criticism. The decision responds to a petition filed by the state Republicanos party against the deputy, the PT, and the Brazil of Hope Federation.

item.title: Onde assistir a Brasil x Noruega no DF: veja a programação
item.description: Brazil faces Norway in the Round of 16 of the 2026 FIFA World Cup on Sunday, July 5, at 5:00 p.m. Brasília time, with the match determining advancement to the quarterfinals. Across the Federal District, numerous bars, restaurants, and public venues are hosting free or ticketed viewing parties featuring live music, DJs, and large screens to create a festive atmosphere for fans. The game is pivotal as Brazil seeks its sixth World Cup title.

item.title: EUA contra comércio do Brasil: Entenda manifestações do governo e de Flávio
item.description: The Brazilian government and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro challenged the USTR’s Section 301 investigation into Brazilian trade practices, with the government claiming lack of legal basis and the senator urging a delay on potential tariffs until after the 2026 elections to avoid politically benefiting Lula. The investigation raises concerns in six areas, including digital trade, Pix, trade agreements, and deforestation, following a public comment period that received around 200 submissions.

item.title: A nova configuração do mapa ideológico brasileiro, segundo pesquisa Datafolha
item.description: According to a June 2026 Datafolha poll, 44% of Brazilians identify as right-wing (15% right + 29% center-right) and 39% as left-wing (26% center-left + 13% left), reversing the 2022 trend when left-wing led with 49% versus 34% for the right. This marks the first time since 2014 that the right leads in the institute's historical series, with women more likely to identify as left (44%) and men as right (50%).

item.title: Em busca de votos, Tarcísio foca na Zona Leste antes do início do defeso eleitoral
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) attended the graduation ceremony of Professional Qualification Schools at CEU Aricanduva in São Paulo's Zona Leste to strengthen his presence in the city's most populous region before the electoral blackout. The event, filled with hugs, photos, and balloons, included Mayor Ricardo Nunes (MDB), First Lady Cristiane de Freitas, and Senate pre-candidate André do Prado (PL), who is backed by the governor. Tarcísio emphasized that the event was deliberately chosen to conclude his public engagements before the Electoral Justice ban on agent participation in such events, aiming to boost his electoral influence in Zona Leste ahead of the October re-election bid.

item.title: ‘Não sou uma sombra do Flávio’, diz Renan Santos, pré-candidato do Missão
item.description: Renan Santos, pre-candidate of the Missão party and MBL founder, stated he is not a 'shadow' of Flávio Bolsonaro, attributing his poll growth to authentic rhetoric and direct confrontation with Lula and Bolsonaro. He reached 7.8% in voter intention according to AtlasIntel, surpassing Caiado and Zema, while Lula leads with 46.3% and Flávio with 36.6%. The Missão party, founded by MBL activists and officially recognized by Electoral Justice in 2023, aims to distinguish itself by avoiding passive alignment with established figures.

item.title: Carluxo vê tentativa de “matar politicamente” Bolsonaro
item.description: Carlos Bolsonaro, former city councilor and Senate pre-candidate, criticized the conditions of his father Jair Bolsonaro's humanitarian house arrest after its renewal by Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes. He claimed that restrictions on family visits constitute an attempt to 'politically kill' the former president.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro visita PL Mulher e posa para foto com antiga equipe após imagem de papelão viralizar
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro announced her resignation as president of PL Mulher following conflicts with her stepson Flávio Bolsonaro, stating she will focus on caring for her husband and daughter. The decision came after a meeting with PL national president Valdemar Costa Neto, who acknowledged the possibility of her withdrawing from the Senate race in the Federal District. PL Mulher shared a photo of the team with Michelle, expressing support after a controversy involving a life-sized cardboard cutout of her.

item.title: Moraes prorroga prisão domiciliar de Bolsonaro
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes extended the house arrest of former President Jair Bolsonaro, who is serving a 27-year sentence for attempted coup d'état. The ruling maintains Bolsonaro under judicial confinement at his residence.

item.title: Linha 6-Laranja do Metrô de SP inicia operação com obras inacabadas
item.description: São Paulo's Line 6-Orange began partial passenger service on Friday, with six stations operating despite unfinished works ranging from 85% to 98% completion. The early inauguration, justified by the government to reduce costs and generate revenue sooner, proceeded despite pending finishes and incomplete integration with Line 7-Ruby. Service will remain free until October as construction continues.

item.title: Ciro Nogueira elogia Lula e diz ter “admiração enorme” por enfrentar a “fome no país”
item.description: Senator Ciro Nogueira (PP-PI) praised President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva for his efforts in combating hunger in Brazil, stating he has 'enormous admiration' for the president. The remark was made during a speech in São João do Piauí, highlighting the fight against hunger as a positive aspect of Lula's administration.

item.title: Gaspar, Lira e Calheiros empatam pelo Senado em Alagoas, diz pesquisa
item.description: A Paraná Pesquisas survey shows a technical tie between Alfredo Gaspar (PL) at 40.4%, Arthur Lira (PP) at 39.8%, and Renan Calheiros (MDB) at 36.4% in the Senate race in Alagoas, with a 2.7-point margin of error. The study, registered with TSE as AL-04491/2026 and funded by TV Pajucara, was upheld after the TRE-AL rejected an MDB-AL request to block it.

item.title: Caso Richarlison: o que deu errado na compra da mansão milionária
item.description: The purchase of Richarlison’s mansion in Angra dos Reis triggered a judicial dispute due to a conflict between possession and property rights, as prior possessory rights were held by another company (WT Administração de Imóveis), despite the title being in the player’s name. Senator Flávio Bolsonaro was listed only as a witness, not a party to the case. The expert emphasizes that checking the title alone is insufficient to prevent litigation in high-value real estate.

item.title: PF identifica 2 codinomes em lista apreendida na casa de bicheiro
item.description: The Federal Police identified the code names 'Barba' and 'Pastor' in a list seized from the home of bicheiro Adilson Oliveira Coutinho Filho, corresponding to former Alerj president Rodrigo Bacellar and pastor Márcio Poncio. Investigations into Operation Unha e Carne revealed evidence of payments, electoral donations, and money laundering involving the two, leading to the fifth phase of the operation in July 2026, resulting in Poncio's arrest and Bacellar and Adilsinho remaining detained. The STF ordered the seizure of approximately R$22 million in assets and issued preventive arrest and search warrants.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro aprende passos de funk após críticas por "dancinha"
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro posted a video dancing funk alongside influencer Wallace Soares, responding to prior criticism of his public dances. The senator, a pre-candidate for President, has been using popular rhythms like funk and sertanejo in his pre-campaign to engage voters, including a recent funk-themed jingle. The move follows his dance at a PL event in Rio de Janeiro, where he also urged supporters to promote his campaign on social media.

item.title: PT cobra explicações de Flávio por ligações com Vorcaro, mas se cala a respeito de Wagner
item.description: The PT demanded explanations from Senator Flávio Bolsonaro regarding his ties to banker Daniel Vorcaro, linked to suspicious financing of the Dark Horse film, while remaining silent on the scandal involving former government leader Jaques Wagner, investigated for receiving bribes from Banco Master. The party’s strategy is to associate Flávio with Vorcaro to politically damage him, while staying quiet on Wagner to avoid internal harm. The PT’s National Directory resolution highlights the 'promiscuity between private interests, political power, and financial sectors' during the Bolsonaro era.

item.title: Porção do escândalo Master relativa a ministros do STF é a única sem investigação encaminhada
item.description: The report alleges that the portion of the Master scandal involving Supreme Federal Court (STF) ministers is the only one without a formal investigation initiated, despite evidence linking banker Daniel Vorcaro to figures such as Alexandre de Moraes, Dias Toffoli, and Gilmar Mendes. It highlights how contracts, messages, and parallel rapporteurships were allegedly used to block evidence disclosure and impede inquiries, while other aspects of the scandal have already seen rapporteurs appointed and awaited PGR opinions.

item.title: Moraes lista arsenal de Bolsonaro e dá 48 horas para ex-presidente entregar armas; veja modelos
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes maintained Jair Bolsonaro's house arrest, revoked his CAC (Collector, Sport Shooter, and Hunter) registration, and ordered the immediate seizure of 10 firearms linked to him, including Taurus, Glock, Caracal, Arex, and SIG Sauer pistols, as well as rifles and shotguns, with a 48-hour deadline to surrender. The ruling cited the incompatibility of firearm possession with Bolsonaro's current legal status, following recent violations of imposed measures.

item.title: Viagem de Flávio aos EUA é tentativa de se livrar de responsabilidade por tarifaço, diz ministro de Lula
item.description: Minister Márcio Elias Rosa stated that Flávio Bolsonaro's trip to the U.S. is an attempt to avoid responsibility for potential U.S. tariffs on Brazilian goods, linking the Bolsonaro clan to trade practices under investigation via Section 301 of the U.S. Trade Act. He questioned the sincerity of Flávio's shift in stance on tariffs, suggesting the senator is seeking electoral protection by traveling to Washington to shield himself from blame over the tariff's negative impact.

item.title: Fachin antecipa julgamento do STF sobre eleição para mandato-tampão no Rio
item.description: Supreme Federal Court (STF) President Justice Edson Fachin moved up the judgment on Rio de Janeiro's interim gubernatorial election from August 26 to August 19, to determine how the state will elect its governor for the term lasting until January 2027. The Court is in recess until August 1, but the in-person plenary session will proceed on the new date.

item.title: Pressionado por caso Master, ex-ministro de Bolsonaro Ciro Nogueira elogia Lula durante pré-campanha ao Senado
item.description: Ciro Nogueira, former Bolsonaro minister and PP president, publicly praised President Lula during a speech in São João do Piauí, despite facing pressure from the Master case investigations. The shift in tone follows over 90 critical posts against the government in 2025 and suggests a possible 'non-aggression pact' with the petista, as revealed by columnist Lauro Jardim. Nogueira is suspected of receiving monthly payments between R$300,000 and R$500,000 from banker Daniel Vorcaro, along with benefits like travel and property use, in alleged exchange for political favors to Master Bank.

item.title: Marina Silva se solidariza com Damares Alves após ataques: ‘todas nós somos atingidas’
item.description: Marina Silva expressed solidarity with Senator Damares Alves after misogynistic attacks and threats, including insults directed at her and her daughter. She emphasized that misogyny must be confronted regardless of its source or target, stating that when a woman in public life is attacked, all women are affected.

item.title: A mensagem de Lula a Keiko Fujimori — e a resposta da presidente eleita do Peru
item.description: President Lula congratulated Keiko Fujimori on her victory in the second round of Peru's presidential election, emphasizing the importance of bilateral cooperation between Brazil and Peru on trade, infrastructure integration, hunger alleviation, and Amazon protection. Fujimori responded by thanking Lula and reaffirming her commitment to strengthening ties between the two nations through mutual respect and shared well-being. She will assume office on July 28, following the formal presentation of her credentials on July 15.

item.title: Renovação de prisão domiciliar de Bolsonaro “não corrige injustiça”, diz Sóstenes
item.description: Federal deputy Sóstenes Cavalcante (PL) criticized the renewal of Jair Bolsonaro's house arrest by Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes, stating it does not correct the injustice done to the former president, although it allows better health care. He argued the decision maintains an unjust situation despite the humanitarian benefit.

item.title: Zema diz que dedo que Lula mostrou é para o "brasileiro de bem"
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Romeu Zema (Novo) criticized President Lula for making a middle finger gesture during a Planalto Palace ceremony, claiming it was directed at 'honest Brazilians,' not criminal groups. Zema argued that under the PT government, decent citizens receive either a middle finger or corruption scandals, despite Lula announcing investments in health, education, and housing during the same event.

item.title: Direita supera esquerda no Brasil, aponta Datafolha
item.description: A June 2024 Datafolha poll shows the right has regained ideological leadership in Brazil, with 44% of respondents identifying as right or center-right, ending a progressive advantage that began in 2022. The survey, conducted among 2,004 voters across 139 municipalities, signals a shifting political landscape ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Datafolha: 44% dos eleitores brasileiros são identificados com a direita e 39%, com a esquerda
item.description: The Datafolha poll shows 44% of Brazilian voters identify with the right and 39% with the left, with a two-point margin of error, giving the right a five-point lead — the first time since 2014 the right has held an ideological advantage. Classification is based on behavioral and economic thinking scales involving social, political, cultural, and economic values, not direct self-identification. Among evangelicals, 52% lean right; among women, the left leads with 44% versus 37% for the right.

item.title: PT cobra explicações de Flávio no caso Master, mas ignora Wagner
item.description: The Workers' Party (PT) approved a resolution criticizing Flávio Bolsonaro for alleged involvement in the Master Bank case, demanding explanations about the financing of the film 'Dark Horse' and linking him to corruption schemes with the bank, while completely ignoring investigations against Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA), who is also suspected of receiving improper benefits tied to the same financial scheme.

item.title: Menções negativas a Flávio na redes predominaram após embate com Michelle
item.description: The clash between Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro resulted in a predominance of negative mentions against Flávio on social media, with 50.8% of posts classified as negative, compared to 20.2% positive and 29% neutral. Michelle led in mention volume (1.76 million vs 590,000 for Flávio) and engagement (6.1 million vs 3.1 million interactions), with two discussion waves: her video and the controversial statement by blogger Paulo Figueiredo that 'women vote poorly'.

item.title: Crusoé: Lula repudia termo “gasto” para educação
item.description: President Lula stated that it is forbidden to use the word 'expense' when referring to investments in education, health, and infrastructure during his administration. He made the remark at the inauguration of the Federal Institute of Mauá in São Paulo, emphasizing that such spending should be seen as investment, not cost.

item.title: Em Minas, ministro de Lula rebate Zema: "Não conhece a realidade"
item.description: Minas and Energy Minister Alexandre Silveira rebuked presidential pre-candidate Romeu Zema (Novo) for claiming social benefits create a 'generation of the useless,' stating Zema does not understand the reality of vulnerable Brazilians, particularly in regions like Jequitinhonha and Mucuri. Silveira emphasized the necessity of programs such as Bolsa Família, Luz para Todos, and gas vouchers to ensure dignity and announced a technical cooperation agreement with the Federal Police to allocate R$ 20.3 million from the Novo Acordo do Rio Doce to combat illegal mining in the Rio Doce Basin, including the purchase of 37 vehicles, nine drones, encrypted communication systems, forensic equipment, and intelligence technologies.

item.title: PT decide direcionar R$ 127 milhões do Fundo Eleitoral à campanha de Lula
item.description: The Workers' Party (PT) has allocated R$127 million from the 2026 Electoral Fund to President Lula's re-election campaign, representing 20.64% of the R$615.3 million it received. The funds are also distributed across federal and state offices, with provisions to adjust allocations to meet gender, racial, and indigenous candidacy quotas. The PT’s share increased by 23% compared to 2022, making it the second-largest recipient after the PL.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro parabeniza Keiko Fujimori, eleita presidente do Peru: 'a próxima peça é o Brasil'
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro congratulated Keiko Fujimori on her electoral victory in Peru, highlighting the rise of right-wing politics in South America and stating that the 'blue wave' will also reach Brazil in the 2026 elections. He linked the Peruvian result to a broader continental shift toward right-wing governance, citing recent victories in Colombia, Chile, and Bolivia. Fujimori’s win was decided by a narrow margin of 49,641 votes after weeks of vote counting and challenges from leftist opponent Roberto Sánchez.

item.title: Lula parabeniza Keiko Fujimori, eleita presidente do Peru, e diz que Brasil quer avançar em agenda bilateral 'ambiciosa'
item.description: Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva congratulated Keiko Fujimori on her electoral victory in Peru, expressing Brazil's readiness to advance an ambitious bilateral agenda focused on trade, logistical integration, environmental protection, and combating transnational organized crime. The election was extremely close, with Fujimori winning by just 49,641 votes over leftist candidate Roberto Sánchez, underscoring deep political polarization in the country. Lula reaffirmed Brazil's commitment to building a more prosperous, integrated, democratic, and sovereign South America.

item.title: Nome de Alexandre Ramagem aparece em lista de bicheiro Adilsinho; ex-deputado não foi alvo de operação
item.description: The name of former federal deputy Alexandre Ramagem (PL-RJ) appears in a list of payments from bicheiro Adilsinho, seized by the Federal Police in the 5th phase of Operation Unha e Carne, showing four deposits between R$18,100 and R$39,708 in September. Although mentioned, Ramagem was not targeted in this operation, though he is already convicted by the STF for attempting a coup and is a fugitive in the U.S., where he has applied for political asylum. The list also references former Rio governor Cláudio Castro (PL) with an alleged R$3.2 million donation.

item.title: Moraes mantém Bolsonaro em prisão domiciliar temporária
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes upheld Bolsonaro's temporary house arrest, ordering him to surrender 10 weapons within 48 hours, following health-related defense arguments and PGR support. The decision comes amid internal family conflict and prevents Bolsonaro from regaining electoral prominence in 2026, preserving his image as a victim.

item.title: Flávio diz que 'mulherada' manda em casa e no Brasil após atrito com Michelle
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) stated that 'women' run the household and Brazil during the 3rd National Communication Seminar of the Liberal Party. The comment came amid a family crisis with Michelle Bolsonaro, who accused him of mistreatment and humiliation. The remark sparked controversy for being perceived as reductive and disrespectful toward women.

item.title: Papo Antagonista: Flávio Bolsonaro pede para Trump suspender o tarifaço contra o Brasil
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro sent a letter to the United States requesting a delay in the tariff increase against Brazil, arguing that the measure should be postponed to prevent trade negotiations from generating electoral advantages for President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. He claims that rushing the tariffs could politically benefit the federal government.

item.title: Kassab nega ter tido contato com Vorcaro: “Nunca estive com ele”
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, national president of the PSD and running mate on Ronaldo Caiado's presidential ticket, denied having any contact with former banker Daniel Vorcaro. In an interview with Metrópoles, he stated he never met Vorcaro, did not know him, and cannot speak for his party colleagues regarding possible connections.

item.title: Solar de Brasília: veja detalhes do condomínio onde Bolsonaro seguirá em prisão domiciliar
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes has extended Jair Bolsonaro's house arrest at the Solar de Brasília condominium in the Federal District after the initial 90-day period expired. The ruling considered Bolsonaro's health, his conduct during detention, and the incident in which a firearm linked to him was seized from an army officer in a traffic stop — a case not prosecuted by the DF Civil Police. Bolsonaro is required to surrender all weapons within 48 hours and remains at the residence with Michelle Bolsonaro, their daughter, and her stepdaughter.

item.title: Lula é o presidente dos empreendedores, diz ministro
item.description: The Minister of Entrepreneurship, Paulo Henrique Pereira, declared Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva as the 'president of entrepreneurs,' highlighting government measures to support microentrepreneurs. These include the Desenrola MEI program for debt renegotiation, a gradual increase in the MEI revenue cap to R$140,000 by 2028, and the expansion of the Contrata+Brasil platform to boost MEI participation in public procurement.

item.title: Moraes mantém Bolsonaro em prisão domiciliar e dá 48h para ex-presidente entregar armas
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes upheld former President Jair Bolsonaro's house arrest, ordering him to surrender all registered firearms within 48 hours. The decision followed the expiration of an initial 90-day humanitarian house arrest period and came amid an investigation into a pistol seized in Bolsonaro's name, found with a military aide from the GSI. Bolsonaro is serving a 27-year and 3-month sentence for crimes related to the January 8 riots.

item.title: Moraes mantém prisão domiciliar humanitária de Jair Bolsonaro
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes maintained the humanitarian house arrest of former President Jair Bolsonaro, granting a request from his defense. Bolsonaro is serving a 27-year and 3-month sentence imposed by the STF’s First Chamber in September 2023 for his role in the January 8 anti-democratic acts.

item.title: Áudio: Campo Largo (PR) recebe título de Capital Nacional da Louça
item.description: The Paraná municipality of Campo Largo has been officially designated as the National Capital of Ceramics under Law 15.453, signed by President Lula and published in the Official Gazette of the Union. The title recognizes the region’s significance, accounting for approximately 75% of Brazil’s professional ceramics production for hospitality and gastronomy, with Senate approval based on a favorable report by Senator Flávio Arns (PSB-PR).

item.title: Lula parabeniza Keiko Fujimori por vitória no Peru: "Conte com o Brasil"
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva congratulated Keiko Fujimori on her victory in Peru's presidential election, emphasizing Brazil's readiness to pursue an ambitious bilateral agenda focused on trade, infrastructure, poverty reduction, and environmental protection. The election was extremely close, with Fujimori winning by fewer than 50,000 votes over leftist candidate Roberto Sánchez, after official confirmation by Peru's National Elections Jury.

item.title: PT define repasses do fundo eleitoral, com R$ 126 milhões para Lula e aumento de verba para Senado
item.description: The PT has defined the distribution of the electoral fund for the 2026 elections, allocating R$126 million to President Lula’s candidacy. The party also increased funding for Senate candidates, signaling a strategic focus on winning key congressional races.

item.title: Confiança do brasileiro no hexa cresce e atinge maior patamar em 3 anos, aponta pesquisa
item.description: Brazilian confidence in winning a sixth World Cup title reached 56%, the highest level in over three years, according to a Quaest poll commissioned by Brahma. The increase reflects positive reactions to the team's performance after an initial draw with Morocco, with notable growth among men (from 40% to 60%) and young adults aged 18–24 (80% optimism). For the first time in over three years, belief in a hexa surpasses skepticism, driven by Generation Z's optimism.

item.title: O elogio de Michelle Bolsonaro a iniciativa de Lula na educação
item.description: Former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro praised President Lula’s initiative to create the National Policy for Bilingual Education of the Deaf, emphasizing that it grants greater autonomy and protagonism to the deaf community and represents a realized dream for a more accessible Brazil. The statement comes amid a family rift with her stepson, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro — Lula’s main rival in the 2026 presidential race — after she claimed she was humiliated and disrespected during a conversation with him about party strategies.
